canonicalFacts.claim: GLP-1 receptor agonists are effective for weight loss in obesity, with tirzepatide showing particularly strong efficacy
Obesity is independently associated with increased all-cause mortality and cause-specific mortality including cardiovascular disease and cancer
Bariatric surgery is recognized as the only effective treatment for morbid obesity

redFlags: Many historical anti-obesity drugs have been withdrawn due to severe side effects
Weight regain is common after discontinuation of effective obesity medications
Obesity significantly increases risk of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and cancer mortality
